sample_unit: individual surgeon evaluations of AI recommendations (14 surgeons x 50 scenarios)

links.outcome: Surgeon-rated clinical appropriateness of LLM recommendations, by surgeon experience and scenario type
links.effect: Mean rating 4.31 ± 0.8; 86% rated appropriate (4-5); Senior surgeons rated lower than Mid-Career (mean difference -0.27, p = 0.001); grey-zone cases lower (-0.19, p = 0.023).
links.quote: Ratings did not differ significantly between Early- and Mid-Career surgeons (p = 0.750), whereas Senior surgeons assigned lower scores than the Mid-Career group (mean difference − 0.27, p = 0.001).

screen.reason: Fourteen cardiovascular surgeons evaluated LLM-generated recommendations across 50 hypothetical clinical scenarios to assess clinical appropriateness, but the study does not evaluate a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
